chapter: Becoming a musician and the organ trio
title: Drifting into music and forming his own group
summary: He did not always know he would be a musician; getting started was tough, but he immediately formed his own group.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was there a point in your career where you knew you were going to be a musician or something happened for you, or was it something like I always knew I was going to be a musician?
No I didn’t always know I was going to be a musician. It just happened, it just evolved that way. But the more I got into it the more I liked it, so that was just the way it happened.
Tell us about what some of your earlier experiences were in trying to get into the jazz field, and was it a tough —

Yeah, it was sort of tough. But I did something that very few people do, I formed a group immediately. I didn’t play around with a lot of people, I just started a group. So that helped me a lot too, because I didn’t have to play within anybody else’s framework, I could, I started right out in mine. So it was rather hard, but that’s what I did.
